description: Stage 3b call derived from the matches in chest-xr/matching/example_3.json. The pulmonary-nodule pair carries a major measurement discrepancy (4 mm vs 6 mm) AND a comparison flip (stable vs worsening), but both differences are handled by Stage 3a deterministic comparators — measurement/comparison errors are NOT free-text attribute dimensions, so this stage does not re-emit them. All matched pairs end up with empty error lists. This is the canonical 'don't invent errors that already have a deterministic owner' example.
